import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
work = Path('/tmp/cp-dc-linkcut')
work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
lock = open('/tmp/cp-dc-linkcut.lock', 'w')
fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {2})
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'abfcfcd99e4f4d0d9740a5add1b718193f690cc6:data_structure/dynamic_connectivity.hpp'], text=True)
base = base.replace('../components/splitmix64.hpp', 'components/splitmix64.hpp')
base = base.replace('std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count()', 'dc_benchmark_seed')
source = root / 'test/benchmark/dynamic_connectivity_linkcut.cpp'
flags = ['-std=gnu++23', '-O2', '-march=native', '-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero', '-DATCODER', '-DONLINE_JUDGE']
variants = {}
for name in ['before', 'outer', 'tree', 'both']:
    code = base
    if name in ['outer', 'both']:
        code = code.replace('while (int x = find_flag(a, 2)) {', 'while (int x = find_flag(a, 2)) {\n\t\t\t\ta = x;')
    if name in ['tree', 'both']:
        code = code.replace('while (int y = find_flag(a, 1)) {', 'while (int y = find_flag(a, 1)) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\ta = y;')
    header = work / (name + '.hpp')
    header.write_text(code)
    binary = work / name
    subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-I', str(root), '-DDC_BENCH_HEADER="' + str(header) + '"', str(source), '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
    variants[name] = binary
tests = Path('/home/qand/.cache/online-judge-tools/library-checker-problems/graph/dynamic_graph_vertex_add_component_sum')
rows = {}
rng = random.Random(20261018)
for case in ['link_and_cut_00', 'dense_00', 'max_random_00', 'uv_swapped_00']:
    answer = [int(x) for x in (tests / 'out' / (case + '.out')).read_text().split()]
    checksum = len(answer)
    for x in answer:
        checksum = ((checksum ^ x) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) & ((1 << 64) - 1)
    samples = {name: [] for name in variants}
    for trial in range(5):
        order = list(variants)
        rng.shuffle(order)
        for name in order:
            with (tests / 'in' / (case + '.in')).open('rb') as stream:
                result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([variants[name], str(713 + 101 * trial)], stdin=stream))
            assert result['checksum'] == str(checksum), (case, name, result)
            samples[name].append(result['ms'])
    rows[case] = dict(samples=samples, medians={name: statistics.median(values) for name, values in samples.items()})
    print(case, rows[case], flush=True)
for name in ['before', 'both']:
    code = (work / (name + '.hpp')).read_text()
    code = code.replace('void rotate(int x) {', 'void rotate(int x) {\n\t\t++dc_rotations;')
    code = code.replace('void splay(int x) {', 'void splay(int x) {\n\t\t++dc_splays;')
    code = code.replace('int gg = t[g].parent, d =', 'dc_rotations += 2;\n\t\t\tint gg = t[g].parent, d =')
    code = code.replace('while (!(t[x].own & flag)) {', 'while (!(t[x].own & flag)) {\n\t\t\t++dc_visits;')
    code = code.replace('auto [a, b] = roots[level];', '++dc_levels[level];\n\t\t\tauto [a, b] = roots[level];')
    code = code.replace('link_tree(edge, level + 1, true);', '++dc_promotions;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlink_tree(edge, level + 1, true);')
    header = work / (name + '_profile.hpp')
    header.write_text(code)
    binary = work / (name + '_profile')
    subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-DDC_PROFILE', '-I', str(root), '-DDC_BENCH_HEADER="' + str(header) + '"', str(source), '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
    with (tests / 'in/link_and_cut_00.in').open('rb') as stream:
        row = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([binary], stdin=stream))
    rows[name + '_profile'] = row
    print(name, row, flush=True)
(root / '.verify-helper/cache/dc-linkcut-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')

exec(open('.verify-helper/cache/dc_linkcut_probe.py').read().split('variants = {}')[0])
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'test/benchmark'))
from dynamic_connectivity_variants import root_cache
lazy = base
lazy = lazy.replace('if constexpr (aggregate) sums.push_back(e());', '''if constexpr (aggregate) {
				if (level == 0) t[x].own = 4, sums.push_back(values[v]);
				else sums.push_back(e());
			}''')
start = lazy.index('t.resize(std::size_t(n) + 1);')
end = lazy.index('\n\t\tedges.emplace_back();', start)
lazy = lazy[:start] + 't.resize(1);\n\t\tvertices.emplace_back(n, 0);' + lazy[end:]
lazy = lazy.replace('sums.assign(std::size_t(n) + 1, e());', 'sums.assign(1, e());')
lazy = lazy.replace('\n\t\tfor (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) sums[i + 1] = a[i];', '')
lazy = lazy.replace('splay(v + 1);\n\t\treturn t[v + 1].size;', 'int x = vertices[0][v];\n\t\tif (!x) return 1;\n\t\tsplay(x);\n\t\treturn t[x].size;')
lazy = lazy.replace('same_nodes(u + 1, v + 1)', '(vertices[0][u] && vertices[0][v] && same_nodes(vertices[0][u], vertices[0][v]))')
lazy = lazy.replace('splay<false>(v + 1);\n\t\tvalues[v] = std::move(value);\n\t\tpull(v + 1);', 'int x = vertices[0][v];\n\t\tif (x) splay<false>(x);\n\t\tvalues[v] = std::move(value);\n\t\tif (x) pull(x);')
lazy = lazy.replace('splay(v + 1);\n\t\treturn sums[v + 1];', 'int x = vertices[0][v];\n\t\tif (!x) return values[v];\n\t\tsplay(x);\n\t\treturn sums[x];')
variants = {}
for name in ['before', 'lazy', 'lazy_cache']:
    code = base if name == 'before' else lazy
    if name == 'lazy_cache':
        code = root_cache(code)
    header = work / (name + '9.hpp')
    header.write_text(code)
    if name == 'lazy':
        unit = (root / 'test/unit/dynamic_connectivity.cpp').read_text().replace('"data_structure/dynamic_connectivity.hpp"', '"' + str(header) + '"')
        (work / 'lazy_unit.cpp').write_text('#include <cstdint>\ninline std::uint64_t dc_benchmark_seed=713;\n' + unit)
        subprocess.run(['g++', '-std=c++2b', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-I', str(root), str(work / 'lazy_unit.cpp'), '-o', str(work / 'lazy_unit')], check=True)
        subprocess.run([work / 'lazy_unit'], check=True)
        print('lazy unit passed', flush=True)
    binary = work / (name + '9')
    subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-I', str(root), '-DDC_BENCH_HEADER="' + str(header) + '"', str(source), '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
    variants[name] = binary
tests = Path('/home/qand/.cache/online-judge-tools/library-checker-problems/graph/dynamic_graph_vertex_add_component_sum')
rows = {}
rng = random.Random(20261026)
for case in ['link_and_cut_00', 'dense_00', 'max_random_00', 'uv_swapped_00']:
    answer = [int(x) for x in (tests / 'out' / (case + '.out')).read_text().split()]
    checksum = len(answer)
    for x in answer:
        checksum = ((checksum ^ x) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) & ((1 << 64) - 1)
    samples = {name: [] for name in variants}
    for trial in range(7):
        order = list(variants)
        rng.shuffle(order)
        for name in order:
            with (tests / 'in' / (case + '.in')).open('rb') as stream:
                result = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([variants[name], str(713 + 101 * trial)], stdin=stream))
            assert result['checksum'] == str(checksum), (case, name, result)
            samples[name].append(result['ms'])
    rows[case] = dict(samples=samples, medians={name: statistics.median(values) for name, values in samples.items()})
    print(case, rows[case], flush=True)
(root / '.verify-helper/cache/dc-linkcut-probe9.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
